review_notes: Read the whole target file and checked related MS93 files (QC2, QPt, QMu, Amalgam) for repeated blocks. The only repetition that spans several proofs is the "Zv ≤ Vv by distance, then rewrite Zv to ZM at an M-vertex" step. It appears three times in the target and four more times elsewhere in MS93. The identities inside exists_omegaZ (the group-word `simp only [commutatorElement_def]; group` equalities) are short calculations, so I did not report them. The relIndex calc chains in hK₀idx and hidx are similar but too short to justify a shared lemma. I did not compile the proposed lemma. Its proof is just the two existing lemmas composed, so I expect no problems, but the repeated block is small, so this is a modest cleanup.

findings.excerpt:
have := zv_le_vv_of_dist h (le_of_eq hwy')
        rwa [zv_of_isMVtx _ hc'.1] at this
findings.problem: The same two-step argument is written out three times in this proof. First, `zv_le_vv_of_dist h (le_of_eq d)` gives `Zv τ ≤ Vv z` from a distance equation. Then `rwa [zv_of_isMVtx _ hτ] at this` converts `Zv` to `ZM`, because τ is an M-vertex. The target has these copies at hZV (line 126), hZw (line 129) and hZνV (line 154). The identical pattern also appears in S46I466aQPt.lean (lines 38 and 134), S46I466aQMu.lean (line 40) and S46I466aQC2.lean (line 213, `sup_zloc_eq`). That makes seven copies. Each time the reader has to re-check the anonymous `this`, the `rwa`, and that the right M-vertex hypothesis is supplied. The target declares no ZM-level form of the lemma, and `zv_le_vv_of_dist` is stated only for `Zv`.
findings.proposed_change:
Next to `zv_le_vv_of_dist` in S46I466aQC2.lean, add
`theorem zm_le_vv_of_dist {z τ : Vtx (puAmalgam h.le)} (hτ : IsMVtx _ τ) (hd : (puAmalgam h.le).treeGraph.dist z τ ≤ 2) : ZM (puAmalgam h.le) τ ≤ Vv _ z`.
Its proof is `by simpa [zv_of_isMVtx _ hτ] using zv_le_vv_of_dist h hd`, or `(zv_of_isMVtx _ hτ).symm ▸ zv_le_vv_of_dist h hd`.
Then rewrite the target uses as:
- `hZV := zm_le_vv_of_dist h hc'.1 hwy'.le`
- `hZw := zm_le_vv_of_dist h hw hyw.le`
- `hZνV := zm_le_vv_of_dist h (ms22_iii _ h20 hb0 hC hcν).1 hd.le`
The hypotheses are unchanged: `h : PUHyp M T L`, and the `IsMVtx` and distance facts already in scope. No new imports are needed, since QC1 already imports QC2. Use the same one-line call in the QPt, QMu and QC2 copies.
findings.benefit: The seven five-line blocks (two-line `have`/`rwa` plus a `by` wrapper) become single terms. The statement `ZM τ ≤ Vv z` for an M-vertex τ within distance 2 of z gets one name. Readers no longer need to follow the anonymous `this` and the `rwa`. A future change to how `Zv` and `ZM` relate has to be made in one place.

evidence.excerpt: theorem zv_of_isMVtx {δ : Vtx X} (h : IsMVtx X δ) : Zv X δ = ZM X δ
